Manual Dim and Restore

Use the vuFileTools - Dim Parent Window code template immediately before the procedure call and vuFileTools - Restore Parent Window immediately afterward. The equivalent Clarion code is:

DimResult = vuFTDimWindow(0{PROP:Handle},90)
MyUpdateProcedure()
RestoreResult = vuFTRestoreWindow(0{PROP:Handle})

Declare DimResult and RestoreResult as LONG variables if you want to capture results. The parent handle must be the same for Dim and Restore.

For report-preview or custom-window calls, use the same sequence. Do not restore immediately after START. The launched child continues running. Use Dimming a Window Started with START instead.

When Window Dimming is enabled, the global template supplies its MAP declarations. For a fully hand-coded application, see Hand-Coded Integration for the nine developer-facing function declarations, examples, and linking instructions.
